0022600021.text: The Houston Rockets arrive 5-0, first in the Southwest and first in the West, on a five-game winning streak and a 3-0 road record, while the Dallas Mavericks are 3-2, fourth in the Southwest and seventh in the West. Houston will be without Marcus Smart (out, forearm strain) and Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and Alperen Sengun is day-to-day with back soreness and a game-time decision. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Santi Aldama (out, knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation), with Naji Marshall (illness) and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Rockets lead this season's series 1-0 after a 128-110 win in Houston on October 21, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
